## Dope Sheets

To keep us organized, I plan to create a **daily dope sheet**[^dope]
for each day that provides the most important information and links
for the day.
   
[ link to old dope sheets has been removed. ]


[^dope]: If you are not familiar with the various meanings of the word dope,
here are some from Websters' online dictionary:

    a. *n.* information, especially from a reliable source [eg, the inside dope];
    b. *v.* to figure out -- usually used with out;
    c. *adj.* excellent.

    I hope all three apply.
